description: Tool arguments arrive as fragmented tool_call_chunks. Each fragment on its own parses into a TRUNCATED argument object, so a consumer reading complete tool_calls per chunk emits a mangled question and never sees the full list. The three fragments concatenate to {"questions": ["When did the pain start?", "Does it spread anywhere?"]}.
